When Americans do things

Each page shows when an activity happens across the day, on weekdays and weekends, with hour-by-hour numbers from 258,954 time diaries (2003–2025).

  • When do Americans sleep? 8 hr 44 min a day
  • When do Americans work? 3 hr 17 min a day
  • When do Americans relax and socialize? 4 hr 40 min a day
  • When do Americans do housework and chores? 1 hr 51 min a day
  • When do Americans eat? 1 hr 06 min a day
  • When are Americans driving? 50 min a day
  • When do Americans care for children and others? 35 min a day
  • When do Americans shower, groom, and get ready? 50 min a day
  • When do Americans study and go to class? 26 min a day
  • When do Americans go shopping? 27 min a day
  • When do Americans exercise? 20 min a day
  • When are Americans on the move (not driving)? 22 min a day
  • When do Americans attend religious services? 8 min a day
  • When do Americans volunteer? 8 min a day
  • When do Americans do civic duties? 0 min a day
  • When do Americans make calls and send messages? 7 min a day

About these numbers

Estimates come from all 258,954 diaries in the American Time Use Survey (Bureau of Labor Statistics and Census Bureau), 2003–2025, weighted to the U.S. civilian population age 15 and older and pooled across years. Times are local clock time. Counts are people on an average day of that type, not a live count. Weekdays are Monday–Friday. How the estimates work.
